source: Creator-supplied locked six-beat copy in the current chat on 2026-08-14; visual route selected by an independent creative room

concept.title: Certain of You, Lost in Us
concept.human_truth: Commitment can settle who we choose without giving us a map for every life we will have to build together.
concept.emotional_arc: absolute certainty in the person -> a shared plan opens -> shared life outgrows the plan -> the instructions fail -> the failed plan becomes a new surface -> they author only the next line together
concept.format_shell: Six-slide causal dream sequence: The House That Outgrew the Blueprint.
concept.public_send_reason: Send this to the person you are sure about, even while the two of you are still figuring out the life around that certainty.

visual_setup: THE HOUSE THAT OUTGREW THE BLUEPRINT. Dream-realism grounded in visible actions. Aachu and Zuv enter an almost-empty shared room with one neat folded blueprint. The blueprint unfolds, becomes their home, grows beyond its own instructions, loses its ink in an indoor rain, then is turned over so they can mark one next line together. Progress only two variables: domestic geometry grows from open to impossible and returns to one deliberate line; body distance moves from approach, to parallel strain, to equal collaboration. Exactly two people, never duplicates, memories, silhouettes, portraits or reflections. Same wardrobe and exact two-inch height relationship throughout this compressed dream sequence; clothing changes state from clean to dusty, rain-damp and faintly indigo-stained. House style is neutral warm ivory paper, fine graphite and ink architecture, transparent indigo/denim watercolor, restrained terracotta accents and pale peach dawn. Surreal architecture stays domestic and open, never gothic, prison-like or disaster-scale. No red thread, heart-shaped paths, compass, puzzle pieces, stars, arrows, labels, signs, clocks, wedding altar, generic embrace poster, split-screen or random writing. Clean upper-middle ivory negative space for exact integrated copy and tiny top-right @a.storyof.two on every slide.
identity_prompt_override: Attach exactly these current identity anchors to every generation call: together-18.jpg for both close faces and their charcoal evening wardrobe; together-21.jpg for full-body couple scale, natural affection, Aachu hair length, Zuv hair volume and beard; face-04.png for Aachu's oval face, expressive dark eyes, brows and long dark hair; portrait-07.jpg for Zuv's dark eyes, thick hair, beard, jaw and adult body proportions. Aachu is 5 feet 6 inches and Zuv is 5 feet 8 inches, exactly two inches apart when standing at the same depth. Aachu wears the charcoal-grey blazer over an ivory top and graphite trousers from together-18; Zuv wears the charcoal-black shirt and dark trousers from together-18. Warm medium-brown South Asian skin, natural adult proportions. No pregnancy inference from alternate references, no fair skin, no child scale, no huge height gap, no generic stock-couple faces, no clean-shaven or straight-haired Zuv, no short-haired Aachu.

slides.copy:
I was never unsure of you.
I was lost inside our life.
slides.emotion: vertigo around the life, certainty in the person
slides.visual: EXTREME-WIDE THREE-QUARTER CUTAWAY COVER. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand shoulder-to-shoulder on the same central ivory floor tile while a dreamlike shared house rises around them from one giant blueprint in the lower two-thirds. Half-stairs, open doorframes and corridors fold in impossible but airy domestic directions. Their inside hands clasp naturally at hip height; each studies a different corridor, yet their torsos remain aligned and touching. Faces are readable and concentrated, never doubtful about each other. Four visible hands total: inner pair clasped with clean wrist-to-forearm attachment, outer hands relaxed beside their own thighs. Architecture dissolves before the clean upper-third paper text zone. No other people, reflections, portraits, silhouettes, ghost figures or literal heart.
slides.pose: Full-length same-depth two-shot, exact two-inch height difference, aligned shoulders, inside hands clasped once, outer hands relaxed and separate.
slides.props: one giant blueprint becoming an impossible open domestic house
slides.continuity_lock: The single blueprint, house geometry, continuous wardrobe and two-person entity lock continue through all six slides.
slides.cta_intent: Stable touch against unstable space creates the one-second contradiction.

slides.copy:
Choosing each other had answered
the easiest question.
slides.emotion: a simple answer before the complexity arrives
slides.visual: SYMMETRICAL MEDIUM VIEW inside one almost-empty shared room. Exactly Aachu and Zuv step away from two separate open doorways behind them and toward one another at the room center. One suitcase remains just outside each original doorway, proving two separate lives without labels. Their eyes lock and their inside hands have just met; one small folded blueprint lies unopened on the floor between their approaching feet. Late-afternoon light and generous emptiness; no architectural complications yet. Four visible hands, each fully attached: the inside pair meet once while outer hands hang naturally at their own sides. No rings close-up, key, altar, heart icon, extra person or reflection.
slides.pose: Same-depth medium full-body two-shot, exact two-inch height difference. Each takes one clear step away from a separate threshold; inside hands meet at center, outer hands stay relaxed.
slides.props: two plain unlabelled suitcases outside separate thresholds, one folded blueprint between them
slides.continuity_lock: This is the blueprint before it opens and the room before it multiplies.
slides.cta_intent: A mutual physical choice, never a wedding-poster shorthand.

slides.copy:
Then life began asking
harder ones.
slides.visual: TRUE OVERHEAD WIDE SHOT. Exactly Aachu and Zuv kneel on opposite near edges of the now-unfolded single blueprint, each holding one separate corner with one hand while the paper itself folds upward into full-size walls, stairs and branching rooms around them. Their bodies turn toward different visible demands but remain close enough for shoulders to touch. Use only three lived traces: stacked moving cartons, one leaking tap and two work bags at diverging thresholds; no labels or microtext. Indigo plan lines split into several routes and their faces show astonished cognitive overload, not fear. Each person has exactly one visible map hand; all other hands are fully hidden by the overhead crop. Architecture occupies the lower two-thirds and dissolves into clean paper above.
slides.pose: Overhead two-person kneel, shoulders lightly touching, heads and torsos turn toward different branches, exactly two visible hands total holding separate blueprint corners.
slides.wardrobe: Same wardrobe, now lightly dusty at knees and elbows.
slides.props: one expanding blueprint, moving cartons, one leaking tap, exactly two work bags, branching indigo plan lines
slides.continuity_lock: The folded plan from slide 2 opens and physically becomes the house.
slides.cta_intent: Make ordinary adulthood feel enormous without turning it into generic symbolism.

slides.copy:
Some days, love did not tell us
what to do.
slides.visual: LOW FLOOR-LEVEL CLOSE VIEW of the same blueprint during a surreal indoor rain. Exactly Aachu and Zuv lean in from opposite sides of the frame, each using one clearly owned hand to hold a separate corner flat. Indigo ink visibly bleeds away until the route is unreadable. Both gaze down at the failed plan; neither looks to the other for rescue. Their expressions are tired and honestly baffled, never angry. Exactly two active hands are visible, each connected through a clean wrist and forearm; all other hands remain fully outside the crop. One unlit lamp and one wall-less doorway stay soft behind them. Rain is restrained watercolor evidence, not disaster spectacle; face and clothing edges remain distinct from the floor and plan. No pointing, shouting, touching across the map, extra limbs, people, reflections, words, icons, compass, heart or solution arrow. Clean upper-left paper for copy.
slides.pose: Tight two-face three-quarter frame from floor level; Aachu owns one right hand on the lower-left plan corner, Zuv owns one left hand on the lower-right corner, exactly two hands visible.
slides.wardrobe: Same wardrobe, rain-damp with faint indigo stains but readable fabric boundaries.
slides.props: one failed blueprint with bleeding indigo route, one unlit lamp, one wall-less doorway
slides.continuity_lock: The blueprint that created the home can no longer explain it. Highest-risk proof for identity, two-hand ownership, spatial integrity, text, palette and story.
slides.cta_intent: A viewer recognizes a day when love remained present but offered no instructions.

slides.copy:
Being lost together did not mean
I had chosen wrong.
slides.visual: INTIMATE EYE-LEVEL REACTION SHOT at a physical dead end in the same impossible corridor. Exactly Aachu and Zuv sit shoulder-to-shoulder on the floor, damp clothes, scuffed shoes and blue-stained fingertips carrying the previous struggle forward. Together, one hand each turns the ruined blueprint over, revealing a clean blank reverse. Their eyes meet in one small exhausted smile: recognition, not consolation or rescue. Each person's outside hand remains fully out of frame; exactly two visible inside hands lift separate paper corners with traceable wrists and forearms. The unresolved corridor remains behind them but the wall above is clean paper for copy. No embrace, halo, heart, extra people, reflections or duplicate hands.
slides.pose: Tight seated same-depth two-shot, shoulders touch naturally, eye-lines meet, exactly one visible blueprint-turning hand per person.
slides.props: one ruined blueprint turned to its blank reverse, unresolved dead-end corridor
slides.continuity_lock: The problem stays unresolved; only the meaning changes. The failed plan becomes a new working surface.
slides.cta_intent: The route failed; the partnership did not.

slides.copy:
Commitment answered who.
We are still learning how.
slides.visual: DAWN RELEASE, LOW FLOOR-LEVEL MEDIUM-WIDE. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand on the same side of the blank reverse of the blueprint, shoulders aligned toward open unfinished space. Each holds one endpoint of a taut indigo carpenter's chalk line with one clearly owned inside hand; their outer hands rest visibly at their own thighs. A fresh blue line has just been snapped across the blank paper and a restrained bloom of chalk dust hangs above it. Both faces are large enough for identity review. They first look along the new mark, then toward each other with a tiny grounded smile. The impossible house behind remains incomplete; only the next line is known. Both stay on the same side of the line so it reads as a shared guideline, never a barrier. Neutral warm ivory dawn, not yellow. No finished destination, embrace, heart-shaped shadow, portal, finish flag, arrow, sign, extra person or reflection.
slides.pose: Full-length same-depth two-shot, exact two-inch height difference, aligned shoulders. Aachu's right hand and Zuv's left hand own the two chalk-line endpoints; outer hands rest at separate thighs, four hands visible and traceable.
slides.wardrobe: Same wardrobe with faint rain and blue-chalk traces, colors unchanged.
slides.props: blank reverse of the blueprint, one indigo chalk line, restrained blue chalk dust, incomplete house behind
slides.continuity_lock: Folded plan -> opened house -> failed instructions -> blank reverse -> one next line authored together.
slides.cta_intent: A screenshot-worthy thesis: the whole future is not solved, only the next shared line.

copy.caption_recommended:
I think I expected certainty to arrive as a map.

But choosing you only answered one question—the most important one. The rest of our life keeps unfolding in rooms we have never entered before.

Some days we know exactly what we are building. Some days we sit in the middle of it, tired and mapless.

I am learning that being lost together is not the same as being wrong for each other.

Commitment answered who. We are still learning how. 🤍
copy.caption_alt: I was never unsure of you. I was learning not to confuse an unfinished life with a wrong choice.
